text:
shout out to everyone who understands the phrase:

"Sheer force of personality"

it will get you into a stupendous amount of trouble, and it will be what pulls you out of the wreckage

it will make allies out of strangers, and believers out of skeptics

it will make new enemies out of old friends, and it will make fierce critics out of the people who taught you everything you know

it will be why you're the person everyone turns to when the ship is sinking

even though you're the one who gunned it at full speed directly onto the rocks

it will be why you keep finding yourself in rooms you have no business being in

and it will be why you're given third and fourth chances, when you never even deserved the first one.

it will be why you leave a trail of broken dreams, broken promises, broken rules, and broken hearts

it will be why women have had enough of your bullshit, and why they can't help but love you anyway

it will almost CERTAINLY be why you die.

but if you've really got it in spades...

it'll be why they still talk about you after you're gone.
